description: This file defines the Fisher class with methods to perform Fisher transformation and its inverse, used for statistical hypothesis testing and correlation analysis.

classes.name: Fisher
classes.description: Provides methods for Fisher transformation and its inverse for statistical analysis.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Performs Fisher transformation at a given value, producing a normally distributed function suitable for hypothesis testing on the correlation coefficient.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Returns the inverse of the Fisher transformation, useful for analyzing correlations.
